༄༅/ /dpal ye shes kyi mgon po brgyad kyi zhal nye bar mthong tshul gyi lo rgyus nges pa rnam rol zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal ye shes kyi mgon po brgyad kyi zhal nye bar mthong tshul gyi lo rgyus nges pa rnam rol zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// lugs gnyis spangs rtogs kyi dpal 'byor thams cad kyis rnam par dben pa'i nyam chung bdag la mgon po mched brgyad kyi nyams snang 'khrul ngor byung ba bden 'dzin a 'thas kyis rang mgo rang gis bskor te rjes 'jug blun dad can yang 'khrul pa'i lam du 'jug phyir bris pa ni/ ngo cag yang ri sgar pa'i tshogs dpon bgyis te/ chu khyi lor 'phan yul du rnyed tshol gyi phyir lag skyong gi brtul zhugs kyis sgar bteg pa'i tshe/ zla ba bdun pa'i tshes gsum gyi nyin/ za gdams chos sde mjal du phyin nas gtsug lag khang gi rtse mo nas yul ltad bgyis pa'i tshe/ ring po zhig gi steng gi nam mkha' la chu 'dzin mig sman gyi mdog can rab tu 'khrigs pa'i dbus su 'brug gi tshogs ches mang ba lang long du 'khrugs shing skad kyi sgra drag po sgrog pa/ glog gi phreng ba 'khyug cing thog ser 'bab pa gzi brjid dang bcas pa zhig mthong bas/ pha ga'i thad du gang yod dris pas dpal ldan rtse zer ba'i dgon chung mgon po gur zhal dang bcas pa'i mgon khang dang bcas pa zhig yod zer bas/ mtshan ma de dag la yid ches nas mjal du 'gro bar brtsam pa'i tshe/ 'ga' zhig gis sngar sa 'bri lha 'khon che bas mi 'gro zer yang*/ rang gi skye ba sngon ma 'ga' zhig dpal mgon zhal gyis rjes su nye bar bzung ba'i dran snang la brten/ gzhan phyogs kyi mgon po'i phrag dog mi yong ba'i gdeng rnyed de phyin pas dpal ldan rtser bslebs/ mgon khang du phyin nas sgo'i steng nas nang du bltas ma thag /mgon khang gi rnam pa med par dur khrod kyi bkod pa 'jigs su rung ba/ steng na sprin nag 'khrig cing 'brug sgra sgrog pa thog dang ser ba dang mtshon cha'i char 'bab pa/ 'og gzhi rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rab tu 'khyil zhing khol ba'i nang du mi ro dang rta ro mang po lang long du 'phyo ba/ phyogs thams cad du sa rlung gis skyod pa'i tshe mtsho de la 'ur sgra dang thug chom 'brug stong ldir ba lta bur sgrog pa/

mtsho de dag gi bar bar du rdo rje'i brag steng du dur khrod shin tu mang por ro langs dang keng rus mang pos gar byed cing sha za dang 'byung po ma rungs pas gang ba/ ro mang po sreg pa dang*/ 'thor ba dur bya dang bya rgod dang gcan gzan gdug pa can dpag tu med pas za zhing gang ba/ mtsho de'i dbus su rdo rje'i brag ri nag cing 'jigs pa'i steng du dur khrod 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang chen po 'jigs su rung zhing brjid pa/ phyogs thams cad du me rlung drag po bskal me ltar 'bar ba'i dbus su khrag zhag gi rgya mtsho'i nang du/ gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs brgyad kyi dbus su dpal mgon po chen po brgyad so so'i yum dang 'khor gyi tshogs mang pos bskor te bzhugs pa/ mthong ma khad 'jigs pa'i yid snang med par de dag thams cad rang snang du shes stabs mchod cing bstod de dam bsres nas/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab pas gar gyi nyams dgus sa gsum g.yo ba ltar mdzad cing gang bcol kyi las bsgrub par zhal gyis bzhes shing*/ khyad par du mthong snang de 'dra ba'i sgrub thabs kyi smin grol las tshogs dang bcas pa bgyis na rung ba'i rjes su gnang ba thob pas dga' spro dang bcas thog steng du phyin/ dar cig bsdad nas slar nang du phyin pa'i tshe/ mthong snang snga ma med par mgon khang ran tsam zhig tu mthong nas slar rten rnams mjal nas/ sgar du slebs ma thag phyag rje sprul sku bas mthong snang dang mthun pa'i bris sku dang*/ bdag rang gis sgrub thabs zhal nye bar blta ba 'phral rtsom bgyis nas/ dur khrod blo mos rgyal gyi grub thob chen po dbus pa smyon pa'i gzim dkyil du mtshams mal bgyis nas mgon po brgyad kyi bsnyen sgrub la 'bad pa'i tshe/ nub cig nyams snang du a tsa ra sngo sangs rus pa dang dur khrod kyi chas gyon pa brgyad bdag gi mdun du gar byed kyin 'dug pa/

lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul yin srid snyam bskyed rdzogs kyi ngang nas bltas pas bdag la dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur mang du byed cing*/ sid+dhi sid+dhi bha wa kar+yan+tu asmin bha ba ka riṣ+ya ti/ zhes zer ba la khyed rnams gang nas 'ongs su yin ci byed sogs dris pas de rnams na re/ nged cag rnams gnas nges pa med/ thub pa'i bstan pa srung*/ ka la phai ro yin/ khyod kyi sar 'ongs| do nub don chen po bsgrub kyi/ 'di dang nye bar armo nig gi rdo yod par dongs shig /bdag cag rnams kyang der 'ong gi zer nas mi snang bar gyur pas/ bdag kyang langs te zla bo gnyis gsum dang bcas nas de dang nye bar armo nig gi rdo yin zer thams cad mjal ba zhig 'dug pa'i sar phyin pas/ mtshan mo mun pa'i smag dang char sprin 'khrigs pas shin tu bsgrod dka' bar gyur kyang phyin nas rdo de'i khar bsdad nas sgom sgrub la 'bad pa'i tshe/ da ci'i a tsa ra de rnams 'khor dregs pa'i tshogs dang bcas bar snang gang bas bskor te byung ba'i tshe a tsa ra de rnams kyis/ yo ga man+t+ra pa ti s+yaṃ/ ma hā sid+dhi kā la prap+ta/ kā ma ar+tha tad+yathā/ zhes sogs legs par sbyar ba'i skad kyi rnam pas bslab bya lung bstan mang du mdzad cing 'dod pa'i don rnams 'bad med du bsgrub pa'i khas len mang du bgyis nas gar song cha med du song ba'i de ma khad/ bdag gi mdun du rnal 'byor pa smug nag rus pa'i rgyan can mi lpags rlon pa gyon zhing mig gsum yod pa/ g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod rlon thogs pa/ shin tu 'jigs rngam che ba zhig byung nas bdag la dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur dpag tu med pa mdzad cing 'di skad ces/ kye ma/ gson dang gsang sngags 'dzin// bdag cag rnams ni sangs rgyas kyi// bstan pa bsrung phyir ye shes dang*// las la grub pa'i tshul bstan gyi// khyod kyang sngon du sgra gcan 'dzin// bram ze'i rigs can de las gzhan// shan+ta pra bha la sogs pa// skye ba mang brgyud bdag cag kyang*// 'brel ba can yin de yi phyir// do nub khyod don bsgrub phyir 'ongs// mang po smra ba'i long med pas// hril gyis dril na 'khor 'das chos// ye shes 'jig rten la sogs pa// ma rtogs ngor snang so sor dbye// don gyi dbyings su ro gcig pa// thub pa'i chos kun snying por gsungs// de phyir gnyis su 'dzin pa'i blo// shigs kyis shig la rbad kyis chod// chos kun du ma ro gcig par// myong ba nges shes skye bzhin sgoms// de tshe srid pa zad pa'i mthar// sdug bsngal chu bo rnams las brgal// rang don chos sku mngon mthong nas// gzhan snang 'gro la phan pa'i phyir// zla ba 'di yi nya tshes la// ra sar shākya mu ni'i drung*// smon lam bzang po'i 'brel ba gyis// sna tshogs 'gro la gang 'tsham pa'i// dam chos phyogs med rgyas par spel// gang 'brel bzang po'i sar phyin to// nges don rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor la// skye dang 'chi ba zhes bya ba// rnam rtog yin phyir 'dir med kyang*// snang tshul rten cing 'brel 'byung gi

/sgro btags 'khrul ngor dam med kyi// slob ma'i rkyen gyis 'pho srid pas// gang gis mi rigs byas na yang*// bzod pa'i go gyon snying rje yi// mtshon chas bsgral 'dren las la sbyor// gnag pas khro dang ngan lan du// ngan gyis gzhal na dam tshig nyams// des rkyen tshe la bar chad 'byung*// nyer gsum so lnga zhe gcig dang*// nga drug re gnyis don lnga sogs// 'phrang las sgrol ba'i gnyen po yang*// nyams dang bstun pas grol bar 'gyur// so lnga'i 'phrang las thar gyur na// bla ma lha dang mkha' 'gro dang*// srung mas dngos nyams rmi lam du// gang dgos skabs ston gsal ston gyi// som nyi spong la dang du longs// sngon nas smon lam las 'brel gyis// mthun byed 'ga' zhig bla ma dang*// slob dpon grwa 'bangs tshul bzung ba// skya ser ma nges 'ga' 'ga' yis// gnas skabs rkyen sel phan pa sgrub// gnod byed dag kyang tshul de 'dras// tshe srog dpal la bar gcod byed// de dag gnas skabs 'ga' 'ga' ru// nor ra re yang legs brtags nas// phan gnod mi 'khrul shes par 'gyur// gzhan yang gnas skabs mthar thug gi// bya ba bzang ngan de dang de'i// lha dang srung ma'i lung bzhin srungs| |chos skyong brgyad kyi bsnyen sgrub kyang*// rtags ldan smin nas de yi rjes// gzhan la phan slad smin grol dang*// bskyed rdzogs rab 'byams las kyi tshogs// gang 'os yi ger spel bgyis pa// dam ldan bu la 'phang med sbyin// dam med rnams la rlung phyogs tsam// bsgrags kyang srung ma'i chad pa 'ong*// de phyir de la nan tan gyis| |zhes sogs dang*/ gzhan yang dus bskal dang mthun pa'i gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi byed las bzang ngan la sogs pa zhib cing rgyas pa dpag tu med pa zhig byung yang kun la bsgrag na mi 'gab pa 'ga' zhig 'dug pas ma bris/ de bstun tho rangs tshur log nas mtshams mal gyi mu mthud nas bsnyen sgrub la 'bad pas rtags tshad 'grig pa byung*/

mtshams grol nas jo shāka la smon lam sogs ji bzhin btab/ slar zla dgon gyi mgon khang du mgon po mched brgyad kyi bsnyen sgrub la 'bad pa'i tshe gong gi 'phros kyi bslab bya lung bstan sogs mtha' yas shig byung yang dus dbang gis sba bar bya ba kho na skabs su bab 'dug pas yi ger ma bris so// zhes pa'ang sngon chad mgon brgyad la lo rgyus ji tsam las med pas cung zad rgyas par byas shing gsang ba'i gnad rnams zhib tu gab par byas pa ste/ 'di'ang shing phag zla tshes bzang por bye ri stag rtse'i kun gsal gsang sngags pho brang du mgyogs par bris pa zog po dbur smyon du pad+ma saṃ bha was btags pa gang des so// //maṅga laṃ//
